control_state: planned: research levels recorded explicitly per trial
expected_behavior: Throughput is cycles per second times hand size. The wiki gives roughly 0.86 cycles/s for the inserter and 2.5 cycles/s for the fast and bulk inserters at normal quality, and hand size grows with inserter capacity research, which the blueprint does not record. The prototype exposes only extension_speed, rotation_speed and the bulk flag, so no items/s follows from it.
notes: Documented cycle rates are not sufficient for a capacity: swing time depends on source and destination geometry, and the pilot's research level is unknown. The adapter therefore derives items_per_second as null/pending and the contract keeps inserter capacity unknown, which the optimistic model relaxes rather than bounds.
Task 09 owns inserter rates; this record is the evidence it starts from.
No controlled game capture has been run for this checkout: task 02 had no Factorio installation or disposable save available, so nothing was measured.
observation_method: Planned (CAPTURE.md 4.11): chest-to-chest and chest-to-belt trials for inserter, fast-inserter and bulk-inserter at each recorded inserter capacity research level; count items moved per interval.
